title_as_printed: Data of temperature and CO2 concentration

footnotes_as_printed.b: ( ) : Measured at different time from C

pressure_note: constant 30 MPa (figure and title: 'P = 30 MPa', 'solubility ... at 30 MPa'); not further specified (loop pressure; no separate partial pressure)

value.what: saturated CO2 concentration after hydrate precipitation, C = M_CO2/(M_H2O + M_CO2) (mass fraction, dimensionless), in the hydrate region (3.0-9.6 C, below the 12 C equilibrium temperature of CO2(l)-water-hydrate at 30 MPa)

value2.what: measured initial concentration before hydrate precipitation (not a saturation value)

composition.other_species: water of unstated quality (text says only 'CO2-rich water' / 'sample water'); no salt mentioned for the solubility runs; sea water is used only in the separate dissolution-rate tests

extra_unmapped: Delta C (concentration change C0 - C, derived)
conversion_needs: mass fraction to mole fraction/molality needs the molar masses of CO2 and H2O (builder)
notes: Printed '--' in Delta T (test 3) and Cooling Rate (test 4) means not measured: empty cells. Brackets and parentheses removed from numbers and recorded in the note column. Test 8 C0 and Delta C are estimated by the authors. Water is described in the paper as sample water from a loop; purity of water not stated anywhere in the paper.
